licenseReview.rationale: Separate scope review based on the OSM Foundation Licence/Legal FAQ and Attribution Guidelines. The OSMF machine-learning guidance states that substantial OSM training datasets are Derivative Databases and, when publicly used, must be offered under ODbL; models trained on them must be attributed in their documentation. Model predictions are not implicated unless they reproduce substantial OSM data. This snapshot is approved for local training/evaluation and public model use only with attribution and an ODbL offer for the complete OSM-derived training/evaluation dataset and reproducible source/derivation materials. Existing source-plus-POI offers do not yet contain trip examples; any model release must be gated until its dataset offer is prepared. Internal engineering interpretation, not legal advice; seek counsel for jurisdiction-specific review.

retentionPolicy: Keep the pinned snapshot, derived POI database, and reproducible data-offer archive together. Publish the ODbL offer whenever a substantial derived database is publicly used.

licenseReview.rationale: Wikidata's official licensing page places structured item data under CC0. This extract uses English item labels, P31 classes, P131 administrative hierarchy, and P625 coordinates; it excludes article text and descriptions. Internal source-use review permits training, evaluation, search, and display of these structured facts. Individual facts and training examples still require separate quality and human review.
